name: labb-js
description: The JavaScript side of the labb repository as one npm workspace: the web app and the design system.

scripts.docs:dev: npm run tokens && npm run skill && npm run dev -w @labb/design-docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run tokens && npm run skill && npm run build -w @labb/design-docs
scripts.design:typecheck: npm run check -w @labb/tokens && npm run skill -w @labb/design-docs -- --check && npm run typecheck -w @labb/design-docs
scripts.typecheck: npm run design:typecheck && npm run web:typecheck
